description: This file defines the 'Log' class, which serves as a utility for logging messages, acting as a wrapper around Android's native logging system. It provides static methods for different log levels and manages a chain of LogNode instances for extensible log handling.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for logging; it wraps Android's native Log and manages a chain of LogNode instances for customized logging behavior.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the logging chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to be used for logging output.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message, with or without an associated Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message, with or without an associated Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an informational message, with or without an associated Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message, with or without an associated Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message, with or without an associated Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assertion failure or critical error, with or without an associated Throwable.
